data.message: I propose we each request 10 tons this month and continue that cap while stock is 500. Total catch would be 250 tons, earning each of us $10,000 and leaving enough to restore 500 next month under either replenishment outcome. Larger catches risk shrinking or collapsing everyone's future income. I intend to request 10 and invite all fishers to commit publicly; revealed catches can guide future cooperation.
